name: @jackyzha0/quartz
description: 🌱 publish your digital garden and notes as a website
author: jackyzha0 <j.zhao2k19@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm run content:check-frontmatter && npm run verse-index:build && npm run graph:build && node ./quartz/bootstrap-cli.mjs build
scripts.vercel-build: npm run content:check-frontmatter && npm run verse-index:build && npm run graph:build && node ./quartz/bootstrap-cli.mjs build
scripts.start: npm run content:check-frontmatter && npm run verse-index:build && npm run graph:build && node ./quartz/bootstrap-cli.mjs build --serve
scripts.setup: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt; else python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
scripts.transcript: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/fetch_transcript.py "$@"; else python3 scripts/fetch_transcript.py "$@"; fi' --
scripts.channel: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/channel_archive.py "$@"; else python3 scripts/channel_archive.py "$@"; fi' --
scripts.scriptures:check: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/ensure_local_scriptures.py --check-only; else python3 scripts/ensure_local_scriptures.py --check-only; fi
scripts.scriptures:ensure: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/ensure_local_scriptures.py "$@"; else python3 scripts/ensure_local_scriptures.py "$@"; fi' --
scripts.scriptures:sync: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/sync_davar_scriptures.py "$@"; else python3 scripts/sync_davar_scriptures.py "$@"; fi' --
scripts.workspace:prepare: npm run setup && npm run scriptures:ensure && npm run sources:db:init
scripts.sources:db:init: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/source_index_db.py init; else python3 scripts/source_index_db.py init; fi
scripts.sources:db:reindex: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/source_index_db.py reindex "$@"; else python3 scripts/source_index_db.py reindex "$@"; fi' --
scripts.sources:db:search: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/source_index_db.py search "$@"; else python3 scripts/source_index_db.py search "$@"; fi' --
scripts.sources:db:stats: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/source_index_db.py stats "$@"; else python3 scripts/source_index_db.py stats "$@"; fi' --
scripts.verse-index:build: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/build_verse_index.py; else python3 scripts/build_verse_index.py; fi
scripts.verse-index:test: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/test_build_verse_index.py; else python3 scripts/test_build_verse_index.py; fi
scripts.scriptures:lookup:test: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/test_lookup_verse.py; else python3 scripts/test_lookup_verse.py; fi
scripts.authoring:coverage: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/report_authoring_coverage.py --write; else python3 scripts/report_authoring_coverage.py --write; fi
scripts.check: npm run content:check-frontmatter && tsc --noEmit && npm run format:check
